message: The school bus from Northfield to Kingsway Academy was withdrawn in September, and my daughter now walks forty minutes along the ring road.
Since the Route 14 bus stopped, my child walks along the ring road to school.
We now drive to school every day because there is no bus; it costs us a lot.
The streetlights on Mill Lane have been out since the storm in March and the path by the river is pitch black.
Bins on Ash Grove were missed three weeks running in October.
The pedestrian crossing outside the library takes so long to change that people cross on red.
Something is wrong with the buses near us.
I'd rather not say. The buses are just unreliable.
The playground at Elm Park has had a broken gate since the summer, and younger children wander towards the road.
